steps.title: 3 SHARP STEPS. ZERO DRAMA.
steps.sub: We eliminated artisan disappearance, inflated material costs, and payment arguments.
steps.s1d: Describe the repair or job and pick your area. In 15 minutes, receive itemized proposals from 3 vetted masters.
steps.s2d: Never send money you have not agreed. Set payment terms upfront and release only after inspection.
steps.s3d: When the job satisfies you physically, tap release. Artisan receives instant payment, backed by 30-day workmanship cover.

testi.title: WHAT OGAS & CONTRACTORS ARE SAYING
testi.sub: Real stories from site supervisors, homeowners, and estate developers.
testi.q1: I was renovating our 4-bedroom duplex in Lekki Phase 1 while living in London. Escrow allowed me release payment milestone-by-milestone only after video evidence. Zero drama.
testi.q2: My 5kVA solar inverter blew up on a Sunday night in Ikeja GRA. Matched with an authorized solar engineer in 12 minutes. The inverter was back up before midnight.
testi.q3: As an artisan guild leader in Yaba, this has given our young welders and carpenters pride. No more begging for your balance after delivering solid steel gates.
